messages:
toni: Heads up — noticed a canary promotion happened automatically from svcAccount `infra:ops-runner` even though that SA shouldn't have `promote_rollout` rights. :warning:

toni: Raw authz log excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T04:21:58Z authz=allow subject=system:serviceaccount:infra:ops-runner action=rollout.promote resource=deployments/my-service canary=true decision=true via=rolebinding/default-promoters id=rb-9876 kms.envelope_key_id=null
```

alex: Which rollout system is this? old deployer or the new rollout-service?

toni: rollout-service v2 (deploy-runner). We merged a role-binding change last week (PR #412) that moved some subjects into a broader selector. I thought it still limited to groups, not individual SAs.

infra-bot: Noted: policy change detected 2026-03-15T04:22:12 UTC — rolebinding `default-promoters` patched. Diff: `subjects: [{kind: ServiceAccount, name: ops-runner, namespace: infra}, {kind: Group, name: ops-team}]`

sara: Is this a case of RBAC drift (binding accidentally added) or a buggy authorizer that resolves selectors too permissively?

toni: Unsure yet. `kubectl get rolebinding -n infra default-promoters -o yaml` shows SA present. I didn't expect the ops-runner SA to be listed.

jon: Also see in the audit logs that kms key id is null. That prevents us from tracing who invoked the protected promote via KMS envelope. If KMS metadata missing, could be a service-side bug in the rollout-service when calling KMS.encrypt().

emma: For immediate mitigation: can we disable auto-promote on rollout-service or remove the SA from the binding? I prefer disabling auto-promote for canaries until we confirm.

alex: Quick mitigation commands:
```bash
# pause auto-promotes globally (runtime flag)
curl -XPOST https://rollout-service.internal/admin/flags -d '{"auto_promote": false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"

# or remove SA from binding
kubectl patch rolebinding default-promoters -n infra --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/subjects/0"}]'
```

toni: I'm going to pause auto_promote and open an emergency PR to tighten the binding to `kind: Group` only. Opening PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra-config/pull/524 (WIP).

deploy-bot: Automated: canary promotions paused (reason: emergency security patch), ticket CREATE-9932.

sara: We should also check the change history for PR #412 — author and approvers. Tagging @alex for review.

jon: Follow-up: engineer owning KMS client in rollout-service (team: eng-runtime) — please add envelope_key_id to audit payload and add a test for it. If you need the spec: audit field `kms.envelope_key_id` must be populated on success/failure.

security-oncall: Assigning incident: SEC-2026-03-15-01. Actions: (1) revoke SA-level promos, (2) ensure KMS audit metadata includes envelope id, (3) patch rolebinding to Group-only, (4) postmortem if we find any unauthorized promotions.

toni: I'll take (1)+(3) and open a PR for an RBAC tighter rule. jon, can you take (2)? sara/ alex — please look at PR #412 approvals and revert if needed.

alex: Ack. Will review approvals and ownership.

emma: Quick note — we saw one downstream service reported a brief config drift alert at 04:23 UTC. Might be related. Adding to incident timeline. :spiral_note_pad:

toni: Updating thread with commands and links in case someone needs to pick it up. Thanks all.
